canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, card surfaces, popover panels — the absolute base of every screen

paper-mist.$description: Paper Mist — Subtle alt-surface for nested cards, secondary panels, and hover fills

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders on cards, inputs, and dividers — the structural line that holds the system together

smoke.$description: Smoke — Stronger borders for emphasis containers and secondary button outlines

pebble.$description: Pebble — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary button text, high-emphasis buttons, nav text — near-black for maximum contrast

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Body text, button text, default heading color — slightly softer than pure black

graphite.$description: Graphite — Secondary text, icon strokes, subtle UI elements

slate.$description: Slate — Tertiary text, nav hover states, subdued iconography

steel.$description: Steel — Muted body text, helper text, less-prominent labels

fog.$description: Fog — Placeholder text, disabled states, link text in rest state

silver.$description: Silver — Disabled iconography, decorative strokes, very light dividers

electric-blue.$description: Electric Blue — Primary brand color — logo, links, key metric highlights, active states, icon accents. Saturated blue against white gives the system its one moment of visual voltage

deep-sapphire.$description: Deep Sapphire — Primary action button background, high-emphasis CTA fill — the single committed action color, used sparingly so it earns attention

soft-mint.$description: Soft Mint — Gray outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

vivid-green.$description: Vivid Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

tangerine.$description: Tangerine — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases.

lavender.$description: Lavender — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases.

conic-spectrum.$description: Conic Spectrum — Decorative gradient — used as full-spectrum conic gradient on brand visuals and logo, never on UI elements

primary-action-fill.$description: Primary Action Fill — High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces. Use as the primary filled action background

satoshi.$description: Display headings — used only at 36–48px for hero and section titles. Weight 500 (medium, not bold) is the signature: headings feel confident and modern but never shout. Satoshi's geometric proportions give the type a slightly editorial, contemporary feel that Inter body text can't replicate.

inter.$description: Body, UI labels, navigation, subheadings, small headings. Inter is the workhorse — handles everything from 11px micro-labels to 30px secondary headlines. Weight 400 is default body, 500 for emphasis and button labels, 600 reserved for important UI labels. The 16px size at lineHeight 1.5 is the most frequent single step (1220 occurrences), confirming 16px as the canonical body size.

geist-mono.$description: Code snippets, technical metadata, inline monospace tokens. Used at 12–14px in code blocks and 24px for large code display elements. Provides the developer-tool credibility that matches Dub's product positioning.
